description: Test Odoo model methods with auto-generated scenarios and get a report showing where and why they fail — without changing your database.
command.clearResults: Clear test results from the editor
config.pythonPath: Path to the Python where Odoo requirements are installed. **Leave empty to use the Python selected in VS Code** (`Python: Select Interpreter`).
config.odooPath: Path to the Odoo folder that contains `odoo-bin`.
config.configFile: Path to `odoo.conf` (addons_path and database connection). Supports `${workspaceFolder}`.
config.database: Database name. Leave empty to use `db_name` from the configuration file. **Use a test copy, not production.**
config.runAsUser: Login of the user that runs the scenarios. Default: the administrator (admin).
config.timeoutSeconds: Maximum time per scenario, in seconds (Linux and macOS).
config.maxScenarios: Maximum number of scenarios per test.
config.allowProductionDatabase: Allow running on databases whose name contains `prod` or `live`. Changes are always rolled back, but running on production is not recommended.
config.enableCodeLens: Show a “Test scenarios” button above Odoo model methods.
config.language: Language of reports and messages. Command titles and setting descriptions follow the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
